reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper and DbAccount types; no existing guard for this rule existed to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked and each of the five link handlers only calls it with its provider name.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts alongside the link handlers, though it is inserted between the param type and the handler type map rather than with the other helpers.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites, a test and a justified widening of the account_sync_source type are changed.

maintainability.why: A single named guard with a clear query is easy to own and to extend to a new provider.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called first by all five link handlers
